summary: Lookout tower on Sawnee Mountain, Forsyth County. A 2000 trip report places it beside a house; its directions mention a private driveway. No source gives its build date or current condition.

facts.design: Tower with a spiral staircase wound around its outside (2000 trip report)

access.note: A 2000 trip report places the tower beside a house, and its directions mention a private driveway. No source describes its access today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list gives 1959 (no units stated; read as feet); the 2000 trip report gives the summit as 1,960 ft or more. The difference is about one foot and is treated as agreement. The record keeps 597.1 m.

notes_for_editor: Sources are thin: Dunigan's list (no build date, operator or status; register codes BLL-64454 and gfc-917 not checked), one 2000 trip report that is the only description of the tower, and Wikipedia for the radio tower. Whether the lookout still stands and who owns it is unknown. The 2000 report places the tower beside a house and its directions mention a private driveway, so access is recorded as private; a site check should confirm. The story's visitor advice was removed because the report does not support it. The county preserve page lists tower climbing among party experiences; this does not describe the lookout. Preserve acreage differs between sources (963 on Wikipedia, over 820 on the county page); acreage is not used in the story. Do not encourage climbing.
